name: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Ltd
title: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Ltd - 543279 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Microfinance credit cycle behind it: slippages fell to ₹106 crore in Q4 and FY27 guidance targets ~1.2% ROA rising to 1.6%, 30%+ growth, and credit cost ~70-80 bps, with no capacity or supply data disclosed.

triggers.label: Slippages ₹155 crore → ₹106 crore QoQ
triggers.quote: our slippages have reduced from ₹155 crores in Q3 to ₹106 crores in Q4

triggers.label: FY27 credit cost 70-80 bps
triggers.quote: our credit cost will be somewhere in the region of 70 to 80 bps

triggers.label: NIM range-bound 8-9%, ~50 bps suppressed
triggers.quote: our NIMs will be range bound between 8% to 9%

triggers.label: Equity raise timing open; Tier 2 first
triggers.quote: our preference will be for Tier 2 to begin with

guidance.quote: We would be targeting somewhere -- anywhere between ₹75 crores to ₹90 crores as a whole for the bank on a quarter -on-quarter basis
on a full year basis in the coming year, we will be targeting somewhere around 67% to 68%
our credit cost will be somewhere in the region of 70 to 80 bps
overall, I think we will be claiming somewhere in the region of ₹450 crores to ₹550 crores
that's the kind of a target that we have in mind

guidance.value: 1.2% in Q1 FY27 rising to 1.6% by Q4
guidance.quote: we are guiding for 1.2% ROA for this June quarter and then gradually increasing to 1.6% by Q4 of this year
we're targeting to grow at around closer to 20% to 30% of the asset size
I would look at anywhere between 1.25% for the portfolio overall put together.
we're guiding for around 3% GNPA, right?

prior_guidance_check.quote: While deposit growth remained below our earlier guidance

red_flags.label: Retail 30-90 bucket stress; Odisha CV and Karnataka MHL
red_flags.quote: the market is highly elevated on CV, though our metrics are significantly lower

red_flags.label: Cost of funds hardening
red_flags.quote: Cost of funds have definitely hardened. It's becoming increasingly difficult to raise money.

evasions.quote: I think I'll have to take this particular part offline
it will be a more detailed discussion and deliberation
